01 Why Kenya · Opportunity

Africa is the perfect testbed for sustainable innovation

The youngest population on earth, leapfrogging technology adoption, abundant renewable energy, and real climate and infrastructure challenges — the ideal sandbox for frugal solutions that scale to the Global South and back.

Youngest talent pool

The world's youngest population and fast-growing design, software and hardware talent.

Leapfrog adoption

Few incumbents, strong digital infrastructure and open, evolving regulation — a live sandbox.

Renewable abundance

Massive solar and renewable potential to power decentralised, off-grid solutions.

Reverse innovation

Frugal products proven locally, then scaled across the Global South and developed markets.

02 About us · The RIFT approach

Rooted in local realities, engineered for global standards

RIFT takes inspiration from the Great Rift Valley — the cradle of human innovation — to drive the next wave of sustainable, locally rooted technologies. The future of impact lies not in abstract concepts, but in concrete, testable products that respond to real needs.

We transform ideas into market-ready ventures through a hands-on, iterative journey: co-designing concepts, prototyping with local partners, piloting in real conditions, and scaling for commercialization.

RIFT is more than a lab — it's a bridge between creativity and market success.

03 Core capabilities

From concept to market — zero shortcuts

A hands-on, iterative journey. Five gated stages, each turning a hypothesis into evidence — from a blank sheet to a scalable, production-ready venture.

STAGE 01

Concept development & planning

Localized, concrete solutions combining hardware, software and IoT — engineered to be locally manufacturable.

STAGE 02

Prototyping & testing

Design and build mechanical, electrical and software prototypes using local workshops and rapid fabrication.

STAGE 03

PoC & field piloting

Test prototypes in real conditions with users — refining product design, service and business model together.

STAGE 04

MVP & manufacturing readiness

Move from prototypes to Minimum Viable Products — scalable and production-ready.

STAGE 05

Deployment & commercialization

Go-to-market through local partnerships, distribution strategies and pilot deployments.

07 Selected work

Proof over promises

A flagship build — a global OEM collaboration with Toyota — engineered and field-tested in Kenya.

CASE 01 — IMV ORIGIN × TOYOTA

A mobility ecosystem for Africa, made in Africa

24 MOidea → working MVP
120 KMfield-tested
~10km / kWh

RIFT supported Toyota (with design studio ED²) to take a new African vehicle ecosystem from a blank sheet to a field-tested prototype and service blueprint in under two years. A bespoke electric powertrain — e-Axle, drive-by-wire and regenerative braking built from scratch — was fabricated with locally CNC-machined parts, alongside a modular hub (ED² × Shigeru Ban Architects × RIFT) and a digital service platform.

Presented at the Japan Mobility Show 2025 — introduced on stage by Toyota's CEO, with Akio Toyoda visiting the booth.

08 Impact · Ecosystem development

Building Kenya's engineering and industrial ecosystem

RIFT Innovation Lab supports the localization and industrialization of Kenya's mobility, energy and productive-use sectors. Alongside product development, we help build local engineering and manufacturing capabilities and develop the next generation of African engineers.

01 / Localization

Localizing products, engineering and manufacturing

We help African companies and international market entrants adapt products to local users, infrastructure and operating conditions — progressively increasing local content.

Redesigning products for African users and operating environments.

Replacing imported components with locally manufactured or assembled alternatives.

Strengthening local suppliers, fabricators and technical partnerships.

Supporting prototyping, testing, certification and the transition to production.

Helping new entrants establish local engineering and manufacturing capabilities.

Local contentIncreasing →

Retaining technical knowledge, expenditure and value creation within Kenya.

02 / Talent development

Developing the next generation of African engineers

Sustained localization depends on a strong local talent base. RIFT combines commercial engineering projects with practical learning — design challenges, internships, mentorship and hands-on engineering programmes.

Real projects. Practical experience.

Students and early-career engineers work on meaningful development challenges across the full product cycle.
